items.summary: HIP: hipEventRecord(ev, hipStreamLegacy) returns hipSuccess, then hipStreamWaitEvent(other_stream, ev, 0) segfaults dereferencing the (hipStream_t)1 sentinel (mutex at 0x1d1). ROCm 10.1 (HIP 7.16.26385) and 10.2 (HIP 7.17.26434), MI300X gfx942, Linux. nullptr and hipStreamPerThread work. Standalone repro in projects/cuda_blackboard/notes.md (Porter section). Worked around in cuda_blackboard 9e0fb86 by recording on the null stream.
